stem_md: 设 $z=z(x,y)$ 由 $F(\frac yx,\frac zx)=0$ 确定，且 $F_2'\ne0$，求 $xz_x+yz_y$。
analysis_md:
$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}&=-\frac{F_x'}{F_z'}=-\frac{F_1'\left(-\frac{y}{x^2}\right)+F_2'\left(-\frac{z}{x^2}\right)}{F_2'\cdot\frac{1}{x}}=\frac{F_1'\cdot\frac{y}{x}+F_2'\cdot\frac{z}{x}}{F_2'\cdot\frac{1}{x}}=\frac{yF_1'+zF_2'}{xF_2'},\\
\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}&=-\frac{F_y'}{F_z'}=-\frac{F_1'\cdot\frac{1}{x}}{F_2'\cdot\frac{1}{x}}=-\frac{F_1'}{F_2'},\\
x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}&=\frac{yF_1'+zF_2'}{F_2'}-\frac{yF_1'}{F_2'}=\frac{F_2'\cdot z}{F_2'}=z.
\end{aligned}
$$
